title: The storage policy table, storage/policy.json (SS 6.3)
description: Not a bridge message. An unknown field is not valid: a reader that does not know the whole table must not apply part of it.

version.description: The format of this file. A reader rejects a version it does not know.

rows.description: A key takes the first row of its namespace whose pattern matches it.

protection.description: A protection class, by its wire value (BC 8.2, SS 6.1).

pattern.description: Matches the whole key. Built from three parts only, which the JavaScript, Kotlin and Swift regular expression engines read the same way: a literal character from A-Z a-z 0-9 _ -, an escaped dot, and a character class of those characters with an optional {n} or {n,m} count.

row.description: A row gives a minimum class or forbids the key name, not both.

item.description: What the row is for. For readers of the file only.

forbidden.description: The storage layer refuses every operation that names a matching key.
